messages:
Maya: Heads-up: I'm opening a docs PR to refresh the onboarding quickstart (switch examples to SDK v2, clarify auth, add region guidance). Will push a short migration section too. PR -> #3451.
Liam: Nice — can you name the new env var? Updating the starter template.
Maya: It's REDWOOD_API_KEY (replaces REDWOOD_KEY). Compatibility layer will read the old var for 30 days. Quick snippet:
```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-xxx
node example/app.js
```
Ivy: Can we include a one-liner for legacy scripts to avoid surprise failures?
Maya: Yes, adding a migration note: check process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY || process.env.REDWOOD_KEY.
Rey: I'll update the JS SDK snippet to show v2 import + streaming example and use the new env var. Example to paste into the quickstart:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const stream = await client.generateStream({ model: 'rwd/fast-1', prompt: 'Hello' });
for await (const piece of stream) console.log(piece.toString());
```
Liam: Please keep a curl fallback for ops folks.
Maya: Adding it. Curl example plus short note about response shapes being the same.
Ivy: Also add an explicit region example — some EU customers hit cross-region latency. e.g., `?region=eu-west-1` in the endpoint.
Maya: Will do. Also adding pro tip about pinning model version for reproducibility.
Rey: Heads-up: starter repo tests currently assert the old env var and non-streaming response. I'll open a matching PR referencing this docs PR.
ci-bot: docs-staging build queued (#9076)
Liam: Quick wording nit: in the auth step, use "set an environment variable" instead of "set env" for clarity.
Maya: Good catch, fixing wording.
Ivy: Can you add a short changelog entry and a line in the migration guide about deprecation timeline?
Maya: Yup — will add CHANGELOG.md blurb and a migration section with exact dates and sample snippets. Planning to merge after two reviews today. Please review when you can.
Rey: Reviewing now, will comment on the SDK usage note.
Liam: LGTM on snippets, left a small grammar nit.
Maya: Thanks everyone — merging once CI is green and I'll post an announcement in #announcements with a short migration checklist. :tada:
